name: Unused states
description: Flags named states that are neither Auto nor targeted by a GoToState call.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, each named `State` that is neither marked `Auto` nor targeted by a literal `GoToState("Name")` or `self.GoToState("Name")` call in the same script. State names are matched case-insensitively. Calls through another object do not activate this script's state, and calls with a non-literal target are not guessed at.
